examples.english: During the rainy season, rainfall increases and river water levels rise.

notes:
Compound of {雨|う} (rain) and ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (amount). Commonly used in weather reports, geography, and agriculture. Measured in millimeters (mm) in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨量|うりょう}⟦{計|けい}→計：02691_kei⟧: rain gauge
- ⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧{雨量|うりょう}: annual rainfall
- ⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧{雨量|うりょう}: total rainfall
- {雨量|うりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: heavy rainfall
- {雨量|うりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: low rainfall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{降水量|こうすいりょう}→降水量：22812_kousuiryou⟧: precipitation — more technical and scientific, includes rain, snow, and all forms of precipitation
- {降雨量|こうりょう}: rainfall amount — more formal synonym, used in technical reports
- ⟦{豪雨|ごうう}→豪雨：05860_gouu⟧: heavy rain — refers to the intensity rather than measured amount
